preconditions: Run runTests.sh from the TYPO3 core checkout root. It starts a container (podman by default, `-b docker` to switch) and runs the suite inside it.

A suite runs against the `vendor/` and `bin/` of the directory it is started from, because the script mounts that directory and nothing else. A fresh clone has neither, and so does a git worktree of a checkout that has them — `/vendor/*` and `/bin/*` are gitignored, so git never brings them. The run then stops at `/usr/local/bin/docker-php-entrypoint: exec: line 9: bin/phpunit: not found`, which names phpunit rather than the directory. Run `CI=true ./Build/Scripts/runTests.sh -s composerInstall` once in that directory first. Symlinking `vendor/` and `bin/` from another checkout does not stand in for it: the target sits outside the one mount and does not resolve inside the container.
notes: Prefix scripted and non-interactive runs with `CI=true`. It drops the interactive container flags, skips the SIGINT trap, and selects the CI phpstan config. Without a TTY the script also removes the interactive flags on its own, but `CI=true` is the explicit form and the one to use from an agent.
Everything after `--` is handed to the underlying tool unchanged: phpunit for the test suites, npm for `-s npm`, composer for `-s composer`.
While iterating, run a single test file or a single test method instead of a whole suite; a full functional run costs minutes per round.

The exception is a change that alters rendered output — a URI, a tag, an attribute other tests assert verbatim. Narrowing then reports the blast radius one failing suite at a time, and each round costs a run. Find the expectations by searching the checkout first and fix them in one pass; `typo3_hint_lookup` for `core-tests` says where they hide, which is largely not in files named `*Test.php`. Run the full functional suite once to confirm, rather than widening the path set round after round.
`./Build/Scripts/runTests.sh -h` lists the suites and option values the checked-out branch actually supports.

options.description: Passthrough to phpunit. A path limits the run to one test file, `--filter <methodName>` to one test method.
Database for `-s functional` and for whichever installer suite the branch carries. sqlite is the default and the fastest; use mariadb or postgres to reproduce DBMS-specific behaviour.
Database driver, only with `-s functional` on mysql or mariadb.
Specific database version, for example `-d mariadb -i 11.4`.
PHP minor version for the container. Only the versions the branch supports are available; check `-h`.
Dry run for the `cgl` suites, and for any other suite the branch lists under it: report issues without modifying files. `-h` says which ones those are.
Split `-s functional`, and the browser suite where the branch has one, into chunks and run one of them.
Enable xdebug towards a listening IDE (default port 9003) for `-s unit`, `-s functional`, and the installer suite where the branch has one.
Container runtime. podman is the default and docker the fallback.

examples.purpose: One functional test file on the default sqlite database
Functional tests on mariadb, to reproduce a DBMS-specific bug
Coding guidelines of the latest commit only, from a normal checkout — from a git worktree it reads no file and still reports SUCCESS
A composer command inside the core test environment

suites.description: PHP unit tests.
suites.whenToUse: Use for isolated PHP behavior, utility classes, value objects, and narrow bug fixes.

suites.description: PHP functional tests, sqlite by default.
suites.whenToUse: Use for TYPO3 services, persistence, configuration, authentication, routing, and integration behavior.

suites.description: Checks and fixes coding guideline issues for all core PHP files.
suites.whenToUse: Use before review when PHP formatting or file headers may be affected. Add `-n` to only report.

suites.description: Checks and fixes coding guideline issues in the latest committed patch.
suites.whenToUse: Use for a focused pre-review check after creating a commit, from a normal checkout only. Its file list comes from git inside the container, and a git worktree keeps its gitdir outside the mounted directory: git fails, the list is empty, and the suite reports SUCCESS having read nothing. Use `cgl -n` where the checkout may be a worktree — it asks git nothing.

suites.description: PHP syntax linting.
suites.whenToUse: Use for broad PHP syntax confidence after touching many PHP files.

suites.description: Static analysis with phpstan.
suites.whenToUse: Use for type-sensitive PHP changes and API contract changes.

suites.description: Lints Services.yaml files with tag parsing enabled.
suites.whenToUse: Use after changing dependency injection wiring in a Configuration/Services.yaml.

suites.description: YAML linting for every YAML file below typo3/ except Services.yaml.
suites.whenToUse: Use after changing any Configuration YAML: site set config.yaml and settings definitions, route enhancers, form setups, RTE presets. Services.yaml has its own suite, lintServicesYaml, because it needs tag parsing.

suites.description: Checks core PHP files against the registered integrity rules.
suites.whenToUse: Use before review after touching PHP files; it catches conventions that neither lintPhp nor cgl covers.

suites.description: Checks the composer.json files of the system extensions for version integrity.
suites.whenToUse: Use after editing any composer.json, for example when adding a dependency between system extensions.

suites.description: Checks the labels.xlf integrity of the site sets.
suites.whenToUse: Use after adding or changing a Configuration/Sets/<Set>/labels.xlf. It is the purpose-built check for site set labels; checkIntegrityXliff does not replace it.

suites.description: Whitespace and EditorConfig linting of the templates below typo3/sysext/*/Resources/Private.
suites.whenToUse: Use after changing a Fluid template, partial, or layout.

suites.description: Checks all .xlf files for validity and deprecated usages.
suites.whenToUse: Use after adding, changing, or retiring XLF labels.

suites.description: Normalizes .xlf files (formatting, attribute order).
suites.whenToUse: Use after editing XLF files, so the diff carries no formatting noise. Add `-n` to only report.

suites.description: Checks .rst files for integrity.
suites.whenToUse: Use for every changelog entry and other ReST documentation change.

suites.description: Verifies that all .rst files referenced by the extension scanner exist.
suites.whenToUse: Use when a deprecation or breaking change adds extension scanner matchers.

suites.description: Frontend build for TypeScript, Sass, Contrib, and assets.
suites.whenToUse: Use when backend UI assets, TypeScript, Sass, or generated assets change.

suites.description: Sass to CSS builder, the branch's half of the frontend build that covers stylesheets.
suites.whenToUse: Use when Sass or CSS sources change. The branches that carry it split the frontend build in two; run buildJavascript for the other half.

suites.description: TypeScript to JavaScript builder, the branch's half of the frontend build that covers backend modules.
suites.whenToUse: Use when TypeScript sources change. The branches that carry it split the frontend build in two; run buildCss for the other half.

suites.description: SCSS linting with TYPO3's stylelint setup.
suites.whenToUse: Use when Sass or CSS sources change. Internally this runs grunt stylelint in the Build directory.

suites.description: Focused CSS build from Build/package.json.
suites.whenToUse: Use while iterating on Sass/CSS changes when a full frontend build is not needed. This maps to grunt css.

suites.description: TypeScript linting.
suites.whenToUse: Use when TypeScript or JavaScript code changes.

suites.description: JavaScript unit tests for the built backend modules.
suites.whenToUse: Use for TypeScript modules with real logic or state transitions. Run the branch's frontend build first so the tests see the current output.

suites.description: End-to-end tests driving a real backend with Playwright.
suites.whenToUse: Use for editor or administrator workflows that only break in the assembled backend.

suites.description: Installs the PHP dependencies of the checkout it is run in, into its own vendor/ and bin/, inside the container.
suites.whenToUse: Use once in a checkout that has no vendor/ or bin/ yet, before any other suite: a fresh clone, and a git worktree, which starts without both because /vendor/* and /bin/* are gitignored. Without it every PHP suite stops at `exec: line 9: bin/phpunit: not found`. It is a precondition and not a step — a checkout that already has vendor/ needs it again only after composer.json or composer.lock changed. It needs no PHP on the host, unlike `composer install` run there.

suites.description: Dispatcher for npm commands inside the TYPO3 core build environment.
suites.whenToUse: Use for npm install, audit, build, watch, and package-script tasks.

suites.description: Dispatcher for composer commands inside the TYPO3 core build environment.
suites.whenToUse: Use for composer dumpautoload, require, info, and dependency tasks.
